settings.heading: Information Display
settings.description: As a carpenter and outdoor enthusiast in Canada , staying warm and comfortable is always a big priority on my list.

settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: A: For over a year now, I’ve been wearing Venustas heated vest for every occasion where I could find myself being cold. From camping, after surfing, hiking, working and even outdoor dinners, Venustas is always there to save the day.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: A: Not only is it flattering and stylish, but it will keep you warm for over 8 hours without letting you down.

settings.heading: Q4: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: A: All these reasons conclude on why I am proud to be a V+ master and represent an amazing company that’s set on a specific mission - providing high quality heated vest that will keep you warm for all occasions.
